name: parcial-ii-microfrontends-clean-architecture
description: Monorepositorio distribuido de Microfrontends (Angular + Module Federation) y Microservicios con Clean Architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend/mfe-products install && npm --prefix frontend/mfe-orders install && npm --prefix frontend/mfe-customers install && npm --prefix frontend/host install && npm --prefix backend/products-service install && npm --prefix backend/customers-service install
scripts.start:all: concurrently --names "HOST,MFE-P,MFE-O,MFE-C,BE-P,BE-O,BE-C" --prefix-colors "bgBlue,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgMagenta,cyan,red,white" "npm run start:frontend:host" "npm run start:frontend:products" "npm run start:frontend:orders" "npm run start:frontend:customers" "npm run start:backend:products" "npm run start:backend:orders" "npm run start:backend:customers"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:mfe:products && npm run test:mfe:orders && npm run test:mfe:customers && npm run test:backend:products && npm run test:backend:customers && npm run test:backend:orders
scripts.test:phase2: npm run test:mfe:orders && npm run test:mfe:customers && npm run test:backend:customers
